analysis.reasonEn: Previous 2 trading days maintained a buy rating, but the current price is below SMA20/50. RSI has exited oversold territory but is consolidating in the neutral zone. MACD histogram shows improvement but remains in negative territory. ADX trend strength is maintained at 26.0, but -DI is above +DI, suggesting downward pressure. The 5-day volatility of -4.62% indicates a continued downtrend. The 52-week position at 27.1% is near the low. Maintaining a wait-and-see approach, further indicator confirmation is needed.
